title: How should you be ORDERING resume bullet points?
description:
Not sure what achievements should go first on your resume, especially when you’ve done a LOT? Here’s an easy way to determine which achievements to list first. Since you have to really earn every new line a recruiter reads always keep your best achievement on top, and work your way down form there. #resume #resumetips #jobsearchtips
